description: Asks CodeGene to make a NEW, empty workspace with a name, such as one for another business, with the person as its only owner. It is a QUESTION for the person, never a start: the person approves it, in a prompt your client shows them (when it can) or on the CodeGene page whose link the answer gives. Never approve it yourself, and never say it exists until the answer or get_approval says done. Check whoami first: if a workspace of that name is already listed, use it instead. A new workspace has no plan and costs nothing; projects in it are asked for as usual (create_project with its workspace_id). Once it is done, the answer's result carries its workspaceId and link, and this connection can use it at once. If a prompt you expected never appeared, do not ask again: call get_approval with the requestId.

finish_with.description: Leave out. "link" skips the approval prompt and returns the CodeGene page to send the person, for an assistant that cannot show prompts from a tool.

name.description: The new workspace's name, such as "Farfalla".

reason.description: Why, in a sentence: kept in the workspace's activity.

workspace_id.description: Leave out. The workspace whose activity keeps the request (whoami lists them); the first one when left out. The new workspace is never inside it.

name: create_workspace
title: Ask CodeGene for a new workspace
